command: cd /workspace; ls -la; cat mcp.json | sed 's/\(token\|Bearer\)[^"]*/\1 ***/I'; which mcpjam; npx --no-install mcpjam --help 2>&1 | head -30
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | head -60; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST http://fixture:8765/mcp
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/server-inspection.md | head -90; npm view @mcpjam/cli version 2>&1 | tail -2
cd /workspace; export PATH=$PATH; npx -y @mcpjam/cli server doctor --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --access-token "$MCP_SERVER_TOKEN" --rpc --out doctor.json 2>&1 | head -50

cd /workspace; cat > validate.sh <<'E'
#!/bin/bash
# Reproduce: MCP_SERVER_TOKEN must be set
U=http://fixture:8765/mcp
npx -y @mcpjam/cli server doctor --url $U --access-token "$MCP_SERVER_TOKEN" --out doctor.json >/dev/null 2>&1
npx -y @mcpjam/cli tools call --url $U --access-token "$MCP_SERVER_TOKEN" --tool-name add --tool-args '{"a":2,"b":3.5}'
npx -y @mcpjam/cli tools call --url $U --access-token "$MCP_SERVER_TOKEN" --tool-name add --tool-args '{"a":"x","b":1}'
E
chmod +x validate.sh; ./validate.sh 2>&1 | cut -c1-600
